sonnet.problem: This card tells that the rich withheld the workers' wages, and that those wages and the harvesters are crying out against them. That is serious sin and oppression, yet the card ends with a joke: "that is one unpaid bill that will NOT stay quiet." A heavy card should show care, not humor.
sonnet.rule: A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke. He can show care instead, marked as his own ("I think this one hurts").
